title: Which settings file wins?
intro: Your user settings (~/.claude/settings.json) set a value. Pick another place that sets the same key to something else, and see which value Claude Code uses.

show.title: The project value wins
show.detail: Project settings rank above user settings, so the team's value is used in this repository.

trace.text: User < shared project: the project value is used.

show.title: Your local value wins
show.detail: Local project settings rank above both the shared project file and your user file.

trace.text: User < shared project < local project: the local value is used.

show.title: The command line wins
show.detail: Settings passed with --settings apply to that session and rank above every file except managed settings.

trace.text: Command line beats local, project and user files.

show.title: Managed settings win
show.detail: Managed settings are at the top of the order and can't be overridden by any other file or flag.

trace.text: Managed settings rank highest: your value is ignored.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose where the second value is set.

quiz.question: Your user file and the project file both have permissions.allow rules. What happens?
quiz.explanation: List settings such as permission rules are merged across files; single values are taken from the highest-ranking file.
